# Data Sources

Data sources are the tables, views and queries *digna* inspects. Create, read, update and delete them. Authentication, pagination and errors are described in the [Overview](index.md).

| Method | Path | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `GET` | `/v1/data-sources` | [List data sources](#get-data-sources) |
| `POST` | `/v1/data-sources` | [Create a data source](#create-data-source) |
| `GET` | `/v1/data-sources/{data_source_id}` | [Get a data source](#get-data-source) |
| `PUT` | `/v1/data-sources/{data_source_id}` | [Update a data source](#update-data-source) |
| `DELETE` | `/v1/data-sources/{data_source_id}` | [Delete a data source](#delete-data-source) |

## List data sources {: #get-data-sources }

```http
GET /v1/data-sources
```

**Parameters**

| Name | In | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `project_id` | query | integer | Yes | Filter by project ID |
| `limit` | query | integer | No | Maximum number of rows to return (default: 200, max: 5000) |

**Responses**

| Status | Description | Body |
|---|---|---|
| `200` | List data sources | array of [DataSource](#datasource) |
| `400` | Invalid limit | [ApiError](#apierror) |
| `401` | Not authenticated | [ApiError](#apierror) |
| `500` | Internal error | [ApiError](#apierror) |

**Example**

```bash
curl -X GET 'https://digna.example.com/v1/data-sources?project_id=<project_id>' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $DIGNA_API_KEY"
```

## Create a data source {: #create-data-source }

```http
POST /v1/data-sources
```

**Request body**: [CreateDataSourceRequest](#createdatasourcerequest)

**Responses**

| Status | Description | Body |
|---|---|---|
| `201` | Create a data source | [DataSource](#datasource) |
| `401` | Not authenticated | [ApiError](#apierror) |
| `403` | Not authorized | [ApiError](#apierror) |
| `404` | Not found | [ApiError](#apierror) |
| `500` | Internal error | [ApiError](#apierror) |

**Example**

```bash
curl -X POST 'https://digna.example.com/v1/data-sources' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $DIGNA_API_KEY" \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{
    "db_connection_id": 1,
    "kind": "TABLE",
    "modules": {
      "data_analytics": false,
      "data_anomaly": false,
      "data_validation": false,
      "schema_tracker": false,
      "timeliness": false
    },
    "name": "<name>",
    "object": {
      "catalog_name": "<catalog_name>",
      "schema_name": "<schema_name>",
      "table_name": "<table_name>"
    },
    "project_id": 1,
    "query_mode": "single",
    "report_empty_datasets": false,
    "snapshot_filter": "<snapshot_filter>",
    "snapshot_query": "<snapshot_query>"
  }'
```
